title: Babur First Battle Of Panipat
definition: The First Battle of Panipat (April 21, 1526) was a decisive military engagement between the forces of Zahir-ud-din Muhammad Babur and the Lodi Empire under Ibrahim Lodi, marking the end of the Delhi Sultanate and the establishment of the Mughal Empire in India.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a cornerstone of Medieval Indian History, frequently tested for its tactical innovations (Gunpowder/Artillery), the transition from Sultanate to Mughal rule, and the geopolitical shifts in Central and South Asia.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Babur First Battle Of Panipat.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Political situation in Central Asia (Timurid legacy)
